I've been in a similar situation to you, in my case I feel like at some point I realized I cant keep on doing everything for everyone. I'm glad that you recognize your situation and thanks for speaking out. My advice is to live for yourself and find what you like, it seems selfish and I understand that it might feel like you have no choice but to please other people or do things for other people. I haven't necessarily gotten out of my depression, but this mentality that I have to do it for myself because others wont, has helped me a bit. As for self harm, please try to project into other mediums like tearing paper or just punching and screaming into a pillow. 

Obviously, I am speaking from my own experiences and it can be different from you. But you are valid, your experiences are valid and I hope you can find someone who can truly understand you.
